details.summary: A complete online shop for gym wear, built for Kurdistan. Shoppers browse categories, pick colours, see prices and reviews, and order through a cart, in Kurdish, Arabic or English. Behind it, the owner runs everything from an admin panel: products, categories, orders, stock and shipments, customer notifications and Telegram order alerts.

sections.title: Storefront
sections.text: A bold home page with product search, light and dark themes, and Kurdish, Arabic and English versions. Customers can shop as guests or create an account.

sections.title: Shop by category
sections.text: Products are grouped into categories, such as compression, oversize shirts, sweat pants and shorts. Each one has its own image and shows how many products it holds.

sections.title: Colours, prices and reviews
sections.text: Every product card shows its colour options, star rating and reviews, price and sale price, with one tap to add it to the cart. Shoppers can sort by best sellers, price or newest, and filter by brand.

sections.title: Dashboard
sections.text: One screen for the whole business: revenue, profit and cost from delivered orders, order and customer counts, the latest orders, and stock alerts for products that have run out.

sections.title: Products
sections.text: Add, edit and remove products with their price, stock status, rating and badges such as New. Each product records which team member added it.

sections.title: Categories in three languages
sections.text: Each category has an image and a name in English, Kurdish and Arabic, so the whole shop switches language cleanly. Extra filters, such as a brand, group products across categories.

sections.title: Orders
sections.text: Orders move from pending to processing, shipped and delivered, or cancelled. A team member can take an order to handle it, and every order can be opened in full.

sections.title: Stock and shipments
sections.text: Tracks each incoming shipment: units per size, product costs, delivery fees, and the profit expected if everything sells.

sections.title: Customer notifications
sections.text: Write a message, choose its type and who receives it (all customers, sponsors, admins or one person), and preview it before sending.

sections.title: Telegram order alerts
sections.text: New orders and every change in an order's status are sent to the shop's Telegram automatically, with product photos.

details.summary: A booking system for a barbershop. Customers book a barber and a free time in seconds, with no account or password. Staff run the day from a cashier screen, and the owner manages barbers, services, products, working hours and earnings from the admin panel, in Kurdish, Arabic or English.

sections.title: Booking website
sections.text: Customers see each barber, whether the shop is open now, and the next free time. Three short steps explain how booking works.

sections.title: Pick a day and time
sections.text: Free times come straight from the shop and are always up to date; taken times can't be picked. After choosing a time, the customer only leaves a name and phone number.

sections.title: Cashier
sections.text: Each barber has a column of time slots. Staff add walk-in clients, start and finish each cut, add services, and see who is waiting, who is in the chair, and the money received today.

sections.title: Barbers
sections.text: Add barbers and their photos, give each one their own sign-in, and see their finished clients, waiting clients and earnings for the day.

sections.title: Shop settings
sections.text: Shop name, phone, address, Instagram and WhatsApp for the booking site; opening hours, time between clients for each barber, closed days, passwords and backups.

team.name: Harzheen Hawzheen
team.description: Founder and lead developer of Shax Store, with more than two years of shipping software. He leads products from idea to launch: fast, secure full-stack websites, AI workflows he engineers himself, and the design and video that give them their look.

team.name: Haryad Massud
team.description: Freelance developer and graphic designer with more than two years of building. He brings code and visual design together, turning ideas into working software, graphics and digital content, and gets sharper with every project.

team.name: Land M. Hama-Ali
team.description: Filmmaker and photographer in Erbil since 2022. At an AMG Performance dealership he averaged four finished car videos a day, and he has led content for brands, events and schools, from the first idea to the final edit.
